title: as salaamun alayk ya hussain
body:
as salaamun alayk ya hussain
<<MINI>>
ya hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
as salaamun alayk ya hussain ya hussain
bar zabaan o delam ya hussain ya hussain
aamadi az madina be karbobala
ba baraadar wa khaahar wa ham tefleha
<<DIVIDER>>
ta ke roshan konid dine haq ra ______
marhaba marhaba ya hussain ya hussain
aaye maula madine se karbobla
bhaayi behnon ka bachhon ka ye qaafela
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaazi abbas ka sar pe parcham khula
aa rahi thi sada ya hussain ya hussain
bhaayi hai mujtaba baba jaan murtaza aur maadar hai jaane nabi fatema
nana salle ala ehmade mustafa
<<DIVIDER>>
in ke dil ki dua ya hussain ya hussain
aap ke ghar ko aada sataate rahe
band paani kiya aur rulaate rahe
aap qur'aan parhke sunaate rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
raahnuma raahnuma ya hussain ya hussain
koshteh dar in zameen shod ali akbaret
qaaseme taaze daamaad o ham asgharet
aun u koshteh shod koshteh shod jaafaret
<<DIVIDER>>
koshteh shod az jafaa ya hussain ya hussain
aa rahi hai imaame zamaan ki sada
as salaam ay ghareeb ul watan marhaba
parh ke rote hain ham zyaarate naahiya
<<DIVIDER>>
ay qateele jafaa ya hussain ya hussain
haaye shaame gharibaan na bhulenge ham
haaye saydaaniyaan aur un pe sitam
bibi zainab chali leke din ka alam
<<DIVIDER>>
zainabi azm tha ya hussain ya hussain
puri rehaan o sarwar dua ho gayi
muntaqel nasl me ab azaa ho gayi
ay shanaawar ali jee ataa ho gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
daulate karbala ya hussain ya hussain
<<MINI>>
ya hussain ya hussain
